from_quote: this subject has been so ably and fully treated by a writer under the signature of Brutus
rationale: Cato (New York Journal, November 22, 1787) refers the reader to Brutus on the small number of representatives. Of the Brutus essays out by that date (I to III; IV appeared November 29), Brutus III (November 15) treats that subject, so the essay is worked out from date and subject. The footnote on Brutus is the editor's and is not linked from.
